map.像素与打印尺寸 使用指南: Pixel and Print Size User Guide
map.像素与打印尺寸计算器按像素数与 DPI（300 为照片级）求可打印尺寸，反算冲印: The pixel and print size calculator derives printable dimensions from the pixel count and DPI (300 for photo quality), and back-calculates the pixels needed for printing, suited to poster and photo output planning.
map.打印尺寸 = 像素数 / DPI × 单位换算（in=1、cm=2.54、mm=: Print size = pixels / DPI with unit conversion (in=1, cm=2.54, mm=25.4); megapixels MP = W x H / 1e6; aspect ratio = W/H; pixels needed at 300 DPI = print size (in) x 300
map.W×H 为像素数，DPI 为打印分辨率。同一张图 DPI 越高，可打印的物理尺寸: W x H is the pixel count and DPI the print resolution. For the same image a higher DPI gives a smaller printable physical size; 300 DPI is the benchmark for quality printing, while 150 DPI suits large posters. The aspect ratio determines the photo proportion (3:2, 4:3, 1:1 etc.).
map.由像素与 DPI 求打印宽高。: Print width and height from pixels and DPI.
map.反推清晰打印所需百万像素。: Back-calculate the megapixels needed for a sharp print.
map.：6000×4000（24MP）@300dpi：宽 = 6000/300 = 2: 6000x4000 (24MP) at 300dpi: width = 6000/300 = 20in = about 50.8cm, height = 4000/300 = about 13.3in, which is roughly A3 at full resolution.
map.：印 30×20cm @300dpi：需 3543×2362 ≈ 8.4MP；低: Printing 30x20cm at 300dpi needs 3543 x 2362 = about 8.4MP; below that it looks soft, so 24MP is more than enough.
map.打印尺寸受 DPI 约束吗？: Is Print Size Constrained by DPI?
map.是，尺寸=像素÷DPI；同像素 DPI 越低印越大但越糊，视观看距离定 DPI。: Yes, size = pixels / DPI; with the same pixel count a lower DPI prints larger but blurrier, so pick DPI from the viewing distance.
map.常见 24MP 可印 A3，大幅海报需 50MP+ 或远距离观看降 DPI。: A common 24MP image can print at A3, while large posters need 50MP or more, or a lower DPI for distant viewing.
